table.retrieve:
SELECT
	item.customicode,
	item.name,
	item.saleprice,
	item.icode,
	item.Packcode, 
	item.SalePrice,
	item.PurPrice, 
	item.SaleDiscPerc, 
	item.PurDiscPerc, 
	item.ReorderQty, 
	item.OptimumQty,
	item.greorderqty,
	item.goptimumqty, 
	item.PackUnits, 
	item.Active ,
	item.Prescribed ,
	item.icatcode,
	item.Refrigrated ,
	item.saleprice2,
	item.saleprice3,
	item.Printable ,
	item.iccode,
	item.packSalestax,
	item.GSTPerc1,
	item.GSTPerc2,
	item.printexpiry,
	item.packcode,
	item.usercode,
	item.lastupdate,
	item.packingcost,
	item.minqty,
	item.saleprice4,
	item.saleprice5,
	newprice=:ar_price,
	stock=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(G.currqty) FROM GodownDetail G WHERE G.ICODE = Item.ICode), 0)
FROM 
	item
WHERE
	item.manfcode = :ar_manfcode AND 
	item.icatcode = :ar_catcode AND 
	item.packcode = :ar_packcode AND 
	item.iccode = :ar_classcode AND 
	item.Active   = :ar_active
ORDER BY
	item.name

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: sum(Round( ar_price  / if( packunits = 0 , 1,  packunits ) *  stock , 2) for all)

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: sum(Round(saleprice / if( packunits = 0 , 1,  packunits ) *  stock , 2) for all)

objects.name: compute_2
objects.expression: sum(Round( ar_price / if( packunits = 0 , 1,  packunits ) *  stock , 2) - Round(saleprice / if( packunits = 0 , 1,  packunits ) *  stock , 2) for all)

objects.name: c_pricediff
objects.expression: Round( ar_price  / if( packunits = 0 , 1,  packunits ) *  stock , 2) - Round(saleprice / if( packunits = 0 , 1,  packunits ) *  stock , 2)

objects.name: c_newstockvalue
objects.expression: Round( ar_price  / if( packunits = 0 , 1,  packunits ) *  stock , 2)
